title: Create a New Component
description: Use Angular CLI to generate a 'Greeting' component and integrate it into the app.
problemStatement:
Your goal is to add a new component named `greeting` to the app. **Steps:** 1. Use the Angular CLI to generate a component called `greeting`. 2. Open the newly created `greeting.component.html` and add a friendly message like `

Hello from Greeting!

`. 3. In `app.component.html`, add the greeting component’s selector (``) so it appears on the page. 4. Start the dev server (`ng serve`) and verify you see both the original AppComponent content and the GreetingComponent message.
hints: Remember the CLI command: `ng generate component greeting`
The selector for the new component will be `app-greeting` (check the component’s TypeScript file).
expectedOutput: The browser shows the AppComponent title and underneath a heading that says 'Hello from Greeting!'.
